Full Stack Engineer (Backend-focused) with 2.3+ years building scalable fintech and distributed systems. Leading system design for a live crypto platform with 10,000+ users and 80,000+ daily events. Core expertise: Node.js, FastAPI, BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Recently extended platform capabilities with a production RAG-based AI support chatbot LangChain, Gemini, Qdrant vector database deployed live on jaimax.com. Proven track record shipping end-to-end products from architecture to zero-downtime production deployments.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Reduced transaction failure rate by 30% — designed event-driven architecture with BullMQ, retry logic, and idempotency. • Improved API response time by 50% and cut DB load by 40% — implemented Redis caching layer across high-traffic endpoints. • Scaled platform to 10,000+ active users processing 80,000+ daily events — zero-downtime AWS infrastructure (EC2, ALB, VPC, CloudFront).
Eliminated manual KYC verification entirely by building an OCR-based automated KYC validation system using Tesseract OCR / Google Cloud Vision across multiple verification workflows.
Engineered three-phase JMC Mining System (Normal , Recovery , Resurrection) — zero revenue loss during any outage cycle. • Sole engineer for JAIMAX FORCE HRMS — full backend , frontend delivered independently, used daily by the entire organization. • Built production RAG AI support chatbot (LangChain , Gemini , Qdrant) — deployed live on jaimax.com, eliminating manual support queries with 24/7 instant AI responses.
